reviews.scope: The independent NumPy float64 slice implements explicit-gradient/frozen-moment features, individually normalized support gradients, checkpoint averaging before family maximization, exact full-string deduplication, global top/random selection with three replay passes, and reference-position/stratum distinct-content quotas. Undefined zero-norm directions and intermediate feature overflow are rejected, not assigned invented scores. Synthetic gradients and historical-action strings exercise the formulas; lexical similarity does not replace gradients. No LoRA extraction, warmup training, ALFWorld, Qwen checkpoint, deployment executor, student SFT or capability comparison runs. Callers must ensure support is public training-side information rather than query answers.

reviews.scope: The CPU NumPy slice computes same-text token-log-probability VFD, reasoning-only source-frozen thresholds, one-eligible-call redundancy estimation and category base costs, sample-SD outcome advantages, correct-only efficiency terms and a clipped GRPO scalar. Linear quantile interpolation and mean-valid-tokens-per-trajectory then group averaging are explicit local conventions, not bitwise equivalence to an unreleased trainer. Callers must supply aligned reasoning windows, valid crops and complete records; arrays cannot establish those semantics. No VLM, crop construction/scoring, CAT rollout labeling, images, policy backprop/update or visual-agent evaluation runs. Finite differences check a scalar derivative, not training. There is no gold-answer/plan interface;binary rewards are external trainer/evaluator inputs.
reviews.cost_basis: The paper uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct,3254examples,406steps,eight questions by eight trajectories per step,8192output tokens and up to20480training context tokens. Eight H100s for about13hours total about104H100GPU-hours, before CAT construction, repeated VFD scoring and seven-benchmark evaluation. This clearly exceeds oneA100/A30or a Mac. Full visual RL/evaluation is not reproduced, with no weight/image downloads or trial runs; only small CPU explicit-array controls execute, estimated in seconds pending runner timing.
